data.one_liner: A simple customizable circular progress indicator widget for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a configurable circular progress bar widget supporting custom colors, gradients, start angles, stroke widths, merge modes, animations, and center text generation.
use_when: You need a customizable circular progress indicator or loader in your UI.
You want to display percentage values or progress with animated transitions and center text.
avoid_when: You need complex linear charts, graphs, or gauges.
strengths: Easy to customize with gradient colors, start angles, and line thicknesses.
Supports ValueNotifier for dynamic value updates.
Includes support for center text generation via callbacks.
weaknesses: Limited to circular progress indicators only.
Older minimum SDK versions compared to modern packages.
